name: Exploded View
description: A clean studio teardown in Three.js: an object turns slowly on a light grey floor and floats apart into its layers, each part tagged with a numbered mono label on a thin leader line.
best_use_cases: How a thing is put together
style: 3D studio teardown: light grey background, shadow-only floor, soft key light, slow turntable, parts lifting apart one at a time with even gaps, Space Grotesk headlines, numbered JetBrains Mono labels on self-drawing leader lines, one part glowing to show why it matters.
